name: room-polygon-edit-simple
description: Simple ladder for room-polygon vertex editing. Opens the 2D editor, injects a free-form (polyroom) room, selects it, confirms draggable vertex handles render, then drives a real synthetic pointer drag on one handle and asserts the room's polygon vertex moved + its area changed.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: add-poly-room
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const id = s.addRoom({ name: 'Poly', origin: [1,1], width: 2, depth: 2, polygon: [[1,1],[3,1],[3,3],[1,3]] }); window.__roomId = id; s.setPlanSelection({ type: 'room', id }); s.recordArea = (window.__store.getState().floorPlan); })()

steps.name: handles-visible
steps.failMessage: polygon vertex handles did not render on the selected polyroom

steps.name: drag-a-vertex
steps.eval: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const id = window.__roomId; const el = document.querySelector('[data-poly-vertex="'+id+':2"]'); if (!el) throw new Error('handle not found'); const svg = el.closest('svg'); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.left + r.width/2, cy = r.top + r.height/2; const mk = (type, x, y) => new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0 }); el.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown', cx, cy)); await sleep(80); svg.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove', cx + 70, cy + 55)); await sleep(80); svg.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup', cx + 70, cy + 55)); })()

steps.name: verify-vertex-moved

waitFor.store: (() => { const r = state.floorPlan.rooms.find(r => r.id === window.__roomId); if (!r || !r.polygon) return false; const v = r.polygon[2]; return Math.abs(v[0] - 3) > 0.1 || Math.abs(v[1] - 3) > 0.1; })()

steps.failMessage: dragging the handle did not move the polygon vertex
